beats.summary: Pam introduces Jim to various office coworkers and shares humorous details about them.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Uh, that is Creed Bratton. He has four toes and he fought in the Civil war.

beats.summary: Ryan asks Jim and Pam to stop distracting him so he can work.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: Hey, uh sorry. Seriously, can you guys… I'm trying to get some work done.

beats.summary: Karen and Meredith bond over having the same thermos and Meredith offers Karen a drink.

evidence.snippet: Meredith (holds out flask): Do you want a little?

beats.summary: Andy and Kevin engage in playful banter about Andy's penguin shirt and nicknames.

evidence.snippet: Kevin: What's that on your shirt?
Michael: Oh, nicknames, yay! Penguin power.

beats.summary: Michael leads a team-building exercise involving picking cards and encouraging connection among employees.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I need somebody to pick a card. One of the new people, please?
Michael: So I think in order for us all to work together well we must come together as a family and then we can all be a king of hearts.

beats.summary: Dwight makes an inappropriate comment which Michael calls out, leading to a tense exchange.

evidence.snippet: Michael (points at camera): They're gonna have… You can't say that, all right?
